<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the unknown sample. The best way is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample and count the distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). This will give the number of unique CH₃ carbons, which corresponds to the number of methyl groups.</thought>
